scripts.build: wp-scripts build --webpack-copy-php && npm run i18n && npm run zip
scripts.i18n-pot: node scripts/wp-cli.js i18n make-pot . languages/html5-video-player.pot --exclude=src && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('languages/html5-video-player.pot','languages/html5-video-player-en_US.po')"
scripts.i18n: npm run i18n-pot && npm run i18n-json && npm run i18n-mo
scripts.zip: node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.mkdirSync('zip',{recursive:true});fs.rmSync('zip/html5-video-player.zip',{force:true})" && %SystemRoot%\System32\tar.exe -a -c -f zip/html5-video-player.zip --exclude=*.log --exclude=__MACOSX --exclude=.DS_Store --exclude=.git --exclude=.github admin build img inc public languages tinymce vendor blocks.php elementor-widget.php html5-video-player.php readme.txt includes.php uninstall.php composer.json
